headline: ScreenConnect Exploitation Anchors a Day of RMM, PLM and HTTP/2 Exposure
standfirst: A KEV-listed ConnectWise ScreenConnect flaw is being exploited via a recovered attacker toolkit, Maersk has confirmed data theft, and attackers are chasing N-able N-central zero-days. Apache and PTC shipped critical fixes, a stolen-credential campaign planted a CI secret stealer across GitHub repositories, researchers described autonomous AI-agent intrusions, and a nine-country operation seized malware infrastructure.
bodyMarkdown:
## Actively exploited

The ScreenConnect campaign exploits CVE-2026-84869, a now-patched critical flaw with a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.9, rather than a new vulnerability, according to the supplied account [[s24]]. The recovered toolkit targets ScreenConnect support sessions, and the flaw is KEV-listed. NVD describes a client-side condition that may allow files to be transferred and executed through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation in certain circumstances; servers are not impacted. The vector requires network access, low privileges and no user interaction, with scope changed. CISA's required action is to apply mitigations per vendor instructions and BOD 26-04, including evaluating internet exposure; its federal due date is not a universal deadline. The MSP concern is that support sessions can become an attack path.

Attackers are also targeting N-able N-central zero-days after a researcher disclosed more than 30; N-able patched the unauthenticated ones [[s40]]. No CVE identifiers, affected versions or exploitation prerequisites were supplied, leaving the practical exposure unclear.

## Breaches

Maersk confirmed data theft amid a $5 million extortion attempt, while the WhiteArmor ransomware group claims it stole 100GB [[s44]]. The confirmation of theft and the group's volume claim are separate facts; no intrusion vector or affected systems were supplied.

An attacker used stolen credentials for 4,837 GitHub accounts to plant a CI secret stealer in repositories those accounts could write to, with execution in at least 1,806 repositories [[s46]]. The stealer targets secrets and cloud credentials reachable by CI workflows. The excerpt indicates likely collection but is truncated, so the full credential exposure is not established.

## Vulnerabilities

Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 has a critical flaw, CVE-2026-119618, that could let unauthenticated remote attackers execute code [[s47]]. It affects 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 and is fixed in 2.4.71; only HTTP/2-enabled servers are affected. NVD maps it to CWE-362, improper synchronization in assign_headers(), but supplies no CVSS score, so the critical label comes from the source description rather than an enriched CVSS value.

PTC has patched a critical remote-code-execution flaw in Windchill and FlexPLM, CVE-2026-126325, scored 9.2 under CVSS v4 [[s34]]. It involves improper input validation and deserialization of untrusted data. The vector shows network reachability, no privileges and no user interaction, but high attack complexity. No affected versions or exploitation evidence were supplied, and it is not in KEV.

## Research

A research account describes attackers using the open-source Cairn AI agent framework to autonomously breach semiconductor, defense and civil-society targets [[s16]]. No actor attribution or victim count was supplied. Analysis: if borne out, the significance is operational—agentic execution compressing intrusion steps—but the supplied evidence is a summary, not a technical proof set.

## Industry

Law enforcement from nine countries, coordinated by Europol, seized hundreds of servers and domains used by Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC [[s15]]. No arrest count or disruption duration was supplied.

nvd.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

nvd.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).
